# sympy_matrix_tools

> Tools for symbolic matrix calculus and checked derivations with SymPy (>= 1.14): undefined matrix-valued functions (MatrixFunction) with the chain rule, coefficients and collection in non-commutative matrix expressions, sums of matrices, a derivation ledger (Derivation) that checks every step of a derivation exactly with random rational matrices, and experimental logic tools (higher-order pattern unification, an Isabelle-style prover with first-order logic, statements about matrices, backward tactics and forward structured proofs, and theorems from the derivation ledger).

To prove or check an argument (logic with matrix algebra) with this library, follow the workflow "Proving or checking an argument" in docs/ai_guide.md, and see examples/loewner_order.ipynb.

Install: `pip install "sympy>=1.14" git+https://github.com/JRF-2018/sympy_matrix_tools`. Import: `from sympy_matrix_tools import *`; the derivation ledger and first-order logic are in `sympy_matrix_tools.derivation` and `sympy_matrix_tools.fol`. All examples in the documents are doctests. Use it to derive and check textbook-size matrix formulas; do not use it for numerical linear algebra or for rigorous proofs.

## Docs

- [Guide for AI agents](https://github.com/JRF-2018/sympy_matrix_tools/blob/master/docs/ai_guide.md): when to use, tested recipes, a workflow for proving or checking an argument, pitfalls of SymPy 1.14
- [README](https://github.com/JRF-2018/sympy_matrix_tools/blob/master/README.md): overview, installation, quick tour
- [Derivation ledger](https://github.com/JRF-2018/sympy_matrix_tools/blob/master/docs/derivation.md): Derivation, Grad, cas, rule, solve_linear, check, report
- [Matrix functions and the chain rule](https://github.com/JRF-2018/sympy_matrix_tools/blob/master/docs/matrix_function.md): MatrixFunction, mat_diff, freeze_matrix_function
- [Matrix expressions](https://github.com/JRF-2018/sympy_matrix_tools/blob/master/docs/matrix_tools.md): mat_coeff, mat_collect, mat_divide, mat_expand
- [First-order logic, matrices and structured proofs](https://github.com/JRF-2018/sympy_matrix_tools/blob/master/docs/fol.md): Theorem, parse_formula, by_auto, by_rule, by_rewrite, by_cas, by_steps, instance, Proof (have/show), Derivation.theorem, explain
- [Fixes and known SymPy bugs](https://github.com/JRF-2018/sympy_matrix_tools/blob/master/docs/fixes.md): bugs of SymPy 1.14 and workarounds

## Examples

- [LQ control with a derivation ledger](https://github.com/JRF-2018/sympy_matrix_tools/blob/master/examples/lq_control.ipynb)
- [Chain rule of MatrixFunction](https://github.com/JRF-2018/sympy_matrix_tools/blob/master/examples/chain_rule.ipynb)
- [First-order logic](https://github.com/JRF-2018/sympy_matrix_tools/blob/master/examples/first_order_logic.ipynb)
- [Loewner order: logic and derivation ledgers together](https://github.com/JRF-2018/sympy_matrix_tools/blob/master/examples/loewner_order.ipynb): definitions as axioms, backward and forward proofs about matrices
